dict.string: Cauco uses macOS Automation only when you explicitly ask it to prepare content in applications such as Mail.
Cauco accesses your calendars only when you explicitly ask it to read or manage calendar information.
Cauco uses Contacts only when you explicitly ask it to find contact information.
Cauco uses the microphone only when you explicitly enable local voice activation.
Cauco uses speech recognition only after you explicitly start a local voice turn.
